title: decision: React 18 is a published peer contract (^18 || ^19 in 33 packages) that is never installed or tested — narrow to ^19, or add a React 18 lane?
body:
Ruled: 6386224339 · letter A · 2026-10-24T15:47Z

Filing gate ②: a decision only the maintainer can make. Raised by the 2026-10-24 whole-repo review; the maintainer approved filing the review's independent cards verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」. Batch-of: 13.

## 维护者速读

一句话问题：我们对外承诺 React 18 可用，但仓里没有任何东西在 React 18 上跑过——锁文件里 0 个 `react@18`、613 个 `react@19.2.8`，没有 18 的 CI 车道，radix 焦点补丁也是对 19 的树打的。要么把承诺收窄到 `^19`（诚实，一次 minor + breaking 说明），要么加一条 React 18 测试车道（为一个没人证明存在的消费者付每次 CI 的钱）。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- 33 packages declare `peerDependencies.react: "^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0"`; root `pnpm.overrides` pins `react` / `react-dom` 19.2.8 and `@types/react` 19.2.18; `grep -c "react@18\." pnpm-lock.yaml` → 0 (control `react@19.2.8` → 613); no workflow matrix mentions React 18; AGENTS.md §2 says "React 18+".
- `patches/@radix-ui__react-focus-scope.patch` was written and tested against the 19-only tree.
- Dedup (`peerDependencies … react|React 18|react@18`): 3 hits, none about this (two release PRs, one unrelated fix).

## Options × real cost × effort

| | what | what a customer sees | effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Narrow every peer to `^19.0.0` (one changeset per package, `minor` with a breaking note per AGENTS 版本号策略) | an 18 host gets a peer warning / refusal at install instead of a runtime surprise nobody can reproduce | S, one PR, 33 manifests; no landed precedent for a peer narrowing in the dump |
| B | Keep the range and add one React 18 vitest project / CI lane | the promise becomes verified; every CI run pays another full suite (today's suite is 19,542 s measured) | M, plus a permanent CI cost |
| C | Keep as is | an untested promise stays published | 0 |

Business meaning: A is "we sell what we test"; B is "we test what we sell"; C is "we hope".

四轴（业务立场）：① 长远：A 缩小契约到实测面，B 扩大验证面以配契约，C 留一个没人验证的声明；② 业务拉动：没有已知的 React 18 消费者（本仓看不到 npm 依赖方，未实测），零拉动默认 remove；③ 防 AI 犯错：A 让一个 18 主机在安装时响亮失败，C 让它在运行时静默坏掉；④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 删掉一个永久义务，B 新增一条永久车道。

Recommendation: **A**. Confidence gap: external React 18 consumers are 未实测 (npm dependents are not readable from the session); if one is known, B becomes the honest choice. Only-① check: 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

裁后执行：A → one os-dev PR narrowing the 33 ranges with one changeset each, AGENTS §2 "React 18+" becomes "React 19"; B → a `react18` vitest project under `projects` in `vitest.config.mts` and a shard in `ci.yml` (governed surface).

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：A 收窄契约到实测面，减少特例；B 扩大验证面；C 维持未验证声明。
② 实际业务拉动：无已知 React 18 消费者（未实测），零拉动默认 remove。
③ 防 AI 犯错：A 在安装期响亮拒绝；C 让 18 主机运行期静默失败。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 删一个永久义务；B 新增一条永久 CI 车道。
Prior rulings read: `peerDependencies react|React 18|react@18` → 3 hits (unrelated); ADR none; thread: none.
